question: Separate spatial objective, acceptance constraints, controller diagnostics and physical execution without score substitution.

global_route.role: constrained optimization objective; no new global PASS threshold
global_route.anchor_authority: frozen case initial world pose and ordered command schedule
global_route.update_rule: Walk advances ideal position by commanded distance along commanded heading; Turn advances commanded heading by commanded relative angle; Stand/Stop retain commanded position and heading
forbidden_updates: deleting or splitting nodes to wash out error
measurements: per-node world terminal XY error vector and norm
signed along/cross errors in the designated commanded segment
wrapped terminal heading error against the commanded phase target
final world endpoint vector and norm
sampled trajectory excursion with explicit coverage
global_route.turn_semantics: Retain relative skill-angle error separately from world terminal heading error. Raw transition yaw includes intended Turn rotation. No time-parameterized ideal Turn trajectory is assumed.
global_route.tradeoff_reporting: Report every component and prefix; final lateral or endpoint improvement cannot erase earlier deviations or a worsened X/heading component. No scalar weights or Pareto winner are selected here.

fixed_local_constraint.anchor_authority: actual state at the frozen EpisodeRunner node-start boundary, before skill execution
fixed_local_constraint.fixed_scope: immutable within the complete original node; treatment-dependent across upstream outcomes
fixed_local_constraint.temporal_scope: Walk endpoint distance, lateral, heading and completion time; not full-path containment
fixed_local_constraint.limit_authority: unchanged boundary/envelope.py definitions and original per-node envelope records
fixed_local_constraint.skill_authority: original node parameters, reset/termination/status semantics; do not apply Walk envelopes to Turn/Stand/Stop
forbidden_updates: reclassifying endpoint PASS as path safety
fixed_local_constraint.upstream_accounting: Retain preceding Stand/Turn/Stop translation and yaw, actual-start anchor, and mission-world error. A new local anchor never resets global error.

profiles.nominal: Preserves current historical task_success semantics; physical predicate, original successful skill completion and original nominal envelope.
profiles.strict: Preserves the separate historical strict_success predicate and all strict violations; it does not replace or weaken nominal.

reference_tracking.role: subordinate controller diagnostic; optional future auxiliary objective
reference_tracking.anchor_authority: predeclared deterministic reference selection rule at the immutable node boundary
measurements: origin/heading discrepancy from both local and commanded frames
reference_tracking.actor_authority: No residual authority over evaluation frames, reference selector, node boundaries or task targets.
reference_tracking.diagnostic_interpretation: Nonzero reference error may be necessary to respect the fixed local constraint. Near-zero reference error does not imply global or local success. No new tracking tolerance is introduced.
reference_tracking.compatibility: Check exact frame transform and endpoint feasible sets; never demand simultaneous zero world error and zero reference tracking when incompatible with a required local profile.

physical_execution.role: mandatory independent execution eligibility; no geometric or reward compensation
physical_execution.authority: unchanged simulation/config, skill status and retained physical-success predicate
measurements: transition standing fraction and speed/angular diagnostics
physical_execution.coverage: Existing execution checks and full-step summaries are distinct from 20Hz retained poses and 10Hz traces. Full-step digest is not a recoverable full trajectory.
physical_execution.scope: Frozen MuJoCo upright/finite/control/completion proxies, not collision clearance, contact certification or hardware safety.
physical_execution.outcome_separation: Keep original physical_success, skill status, completeness and task outcomes separate. TIMEOUT can preserve physical survival; corridor failure is not itself instability. The original sequence physical_success also requires sequence completeness.

optimization_and_claims.objective: Reduce fixed mission-world route/endpoint errors subject to physical execution, original skill completion and the predeclared local profile; retain the global error vector rather than an unqualified scalar winner.
optimization_and_claims.default_historical_task_profile: nominal; no historical gate is reopened by this decision
optimization_and_claims.profile_freeze: A future experiment must declare nominal/strict gate roles and comparison criteria before training/acquisition; both original profiles must always be reported.
optimization_and_claims.nominal_bounded_global_gain: Requires physical eligibility, complete original skills, nominal eligibility and same-reference baseline comparison; disclose every strict regression and component tradeoff. Never describe it as strict corridor-preserving gain.
optimization_and_claims.strict_corridor_preserving_global_gain: Additionally requires unchanged strict endpoint eligibility and the declared paired regression checks. This claim still does not certify continuous or environmental containment.
optimization_and_claims.outside_required_profile: Retain as global improvement outside required local eligibility; cannot become overall PASS via weighted reward, frame rotation or profile switching.
optimization_and_claims.same_frame_learning: Compare each learned actor only with its own residual-off reference baseline; reference selection improvement is not learned gain.
optimization_and_claims.tracking_priority: Tracking and effort are diagnostic/subordinate to world objective and eligibility; no reward implementation or coefficients are selected.
optimization_and_claims.missing_evidence: Missing required metrics, trace coverage or provenance prevents the corresponding claim; do not silently treat unavailable evidence as PASS.

feasibility.level_1_endpoint_geometry: Static intersection of declared terminal position/heading constraints; report an empty intersection or positive constrained-error lower bound explicitly.
feasibility.level_2_path_geometry: Requires an independently specified path/footprint corridor and coverage; endpoint acceptance is insufficient.
feasibility.level_3_dynamic_authority: Whether the frozen policy plus bounded residual and activation window can attain a feasible path within time remains unverified here.
feasibility.response_to_conflict: Preserve the required constraint and negative result. Accept a nonzero constrained global optimum or report incompatible hard goals; changing the task requires a separate authorized contract/version, never a historical score change.

stopping_boundary: No new physics, PPO, reward/observation/gain/PD/threshold changes, Console extension or Phase3A.5 execution.
